# Fictional mixed-page fixture

`build-mixed-page-pdf.cjs` generates a PDF from caller-supplied fictional lines: a native text layer plus an embedded image region produced locally with Poppler. The frozen expected inputs are recorded before extraction. No captured report, credential or network access is involved.

Restored October 26, 2026 from the established ignored `SOURCE_CAPTURES/ACCEPT-009/build-mixed-page-pdf.cjs` generator, source SHA-256 `86972024b3e1eea254eacc6dee9b528ba79ddbb44aae3ac09f970fec63fe8c45`. Changes are limited to the tracked location/import path, resolving Poppler from `CRP_PDFTOPPM_EXE` or PATH instead of a fixed Windows directory, and a bounded hidden renderer process. Test assertions and expected facts are unchanged. This tracked source removes the clean-worktree dependency on private capture folders.
